title: add rag agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Provide first-class RAG templates and agent/tool-calling examples to accelerate developer onboarding and prevent quality regressions; this PR adds reusable templates, quickstarts for the docs site, and 3 runnable examples for the redwood-examples repo. Changes: 1) new templates under examples/rag/templates: 'faq-bot', 'support-assistant', 'doc-search' with config and recommended prompt patterns; 2) agent/tool-calling quickstarts under examples/agents including HTTP tool example, SQL tool example, and a plugin-style calendar tool; 3) docs site updates under redwood-docs/content/quickstarts with step-by-step guides, config snippets, and screenshots; 4) integration tests and small test harness for CI to validate example runs. Testing: added unit tests for template loader, e2e smoke test that runs a mocked tool call, and docs CI that builds the quickstart pages. Backwards compatibility: templates are opt-in and do not change existing runtime behavior. Follow-ups: add additional language locales and telemetry hooks (ENG-8401). Checklist: [x] templates added [x] quickstarts written [x] examples runnable in CI [x] docs built and linked [x] reviewers addressed comments.
